gates.note: Closed-centerline/data-integrity precondition; not a time-evolution Helmholtz theorem test.
Resolution convergence of finite-core energy and relative-equilibrium residual.
Unit-circulation line integral around local meridians; numerical/topological consistency gate.
Main scientific falsifier: shape must be stationary up to rigid translation, rigid rotation, and tangential reparameterization.
Circulation reversal and mirror covariance audit; primarily an implementation/branch-control gate.
